issues.description: PersonService.addChild has inconsistent parameter order/roles between the template/problem statement and the reference solution. The problem statement and template specify `addChild(Person person, Person child)` where the first argument is the parent/person to be updated and the second is the child. The solution implements `addChild(Person child, Person person)`, swapping parameter order and semantic roles. This can confuse students and risks incorrect implementations or mismatched expectations when calling the method (e.g., from PersonResource, which calls `addChild(person, persistedChild)`).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the solution with the template/specification by changing the signature to `public Person addChild(Person person, Person child)` and updating the implementation accordingly: validate `child.getParents().size() < 2`, then `person.getChildren().add(child)`, then `return personRepository.save(person)`.
